**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/21 (Sun) 21:42
- [FACT] The text analyzed is a resolution from the Kherson District Zemstvo Assembly from June 26, 1917.
- [FACT] The resolution states that Ukraine should be part of the federal-democratic Russian Republic as a national territorial autonomous unit.
- [FACT] The Kherson district has 75% of the Ukrainian population and cannot be separated from the Ukrainian regions.
- [FACT] H. A. Morgun was elected as a delegate to the Ukrainian Congress in Odesa.
- [FACT] The Ukrainian Central Council was allocated 10,000 karbovanets.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant summarized the resolution, stating it supports the Ukrainian Central Rada and allocates funds to the Ukrainian Central Council.
- [USER] Asked what kind of system should be in the state to which Ukraine belongs.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant responded that the state should be a federal democracy, allowing Ukraine autonomy as a national territorial unit.
- [USER] Inquired whether the Kherson province supported the Central Rada.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant noted that the text does not mention the Kherson province's overall support for the Central Rada, only that the Kherson District Zemstvo Assembly recognized its demands and promised support.
- [USER] Asked how Ukraine associated itself with Kherson province.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant explained that the Kherson district's significant Ukrainian population suggests it is part of the Ukrainian regions, but the nature of the association is unclear from the text.
